outputs.explanation: Panel A is a representative macroscopic image comparing intestines of two mice; no quantification or statistics are shown, so replicate reporting is not required.
Panel B shows representative H&E histology sections without quantification, so no replicate information is needed.

replicate_statements: The mean numbers and sizes of intestinal polyps in ApcMin/+ mice with different Asef and Asef2 genotypes at 4 months of age (n=8–18 per genotype). *P<0.05; ***P<0.001.
outputs.explanation: This panel shows box plots and bar charts of polyp number/size with significance markers; the legend states n=8–18 per genotype, with mice per genotype clear from context, satisfying both n-number and replicate type.

replicate_statements: Kaplan–Meier survival curves of Asef2+/+ApcMin/+, Asef2+/−ApcMin/+ and Asef2−/−ApcMin/+ mice (n=24–27 per genotype).
outputs.explanation: Kaplan-Meier survival curves report n=24–27 mice per genotype, providing both the number and type (animals) of replicates.

replicate_statements: The amounts of GTP‐bound Rac1 and Cdc42 in polyps of ApcMin/+ and Asef−/−Asef2−/−ApcMin/+ mice. GTP‐bound GTPases were precipitated using GST–PAK CRIB coupled to glutathione–Sepharose beads and detected by immunoblotting with the indicated antibodies (for Rac1 and Cdc42). The total amount of GTPases in the lysates before pulldown assays were also analysed.
outputs.explanation: The bar graph quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 shows an error bar (indicating averaged replicate data), but the legend gives no n-number or description of the replicate type (e.g., number of mice/experiments) used to generate this quantification.
Panel F shows representative immunohistochemistry images without quantification, so replicate reporting is not applicable.

replicate_statements: Immunoblotting analysis and zymography of the normal intestinal mucosa (N) and polyps (P) of ApcMin/+ and Asef−/−ApcMin/+ mice. Tissue lysates were subjected to immunoblotting with antibodies specific for the indicated proteins. Polyps of similar sizes of ApcMin/+ and Asef−/−ApcMin/+ mice were used for experiments.
outputs.explanation: The 'Relative expression' bar chart with error bars and significance asterisks (*) indicates quantification across replicates, but the legend provides no n-number or replicate type (e.g., number of mice or independent experiments) for this quantification.
